title: Pricing & quota rollout: SKU mapping, per-customer limits, and billing comms
creator: Jonah Rivera
description: Coordination ticket for launching the new pricing SKUs, per-customer capacity limits, and related billing communications. Scope includes SKU mapping from legacy tiers, finalizing limits & grace periods, billing pipeline changes (invoicing and metering), public release notes, and sales enablement artifacts. Work spans Product, Eng, Billing/Finance, Console, Docs, and Sales. Goal: zero-billing-surprises migration for existing customers and clear purchase path for new customers.
acceptance_criteria: SKU catalog published in Console and API with stable identifiers
Billing system emits new metering events and invoices align with SKU definitions
Migration path documented and tested for customers on legacy tiers (migrations <-> opt-in)
Release notes drafted and approved by Legal/Finance and published at launch
Sales enablement package (one-pager, pricing calculator, objection playbook) reviewed and shared with AE team
Customer support playbook and escalation matrix published in Confluence
checklist: Finalize SKU names and capacity buckets (P0)
Confirm per-tenant soft and hard limits and grace window (P0)
Billing pipeline changes deployed to staging and smoke-tested (ENG-2893)
Add Console UI labels and limit indicators (ENG-2910)
Draft customer-facing billing FAQ and migration emails (Docs)
Create sales one-pager + pricing scenarios spreadsheet
Coordinate release notes cadence with release-engineering
Prepare rollback plan and mitigation runbook

rollout_plan: Phase 0 — Internal pilot (2025-02-18 to 2025-02-24): small set of internal orgs and partner customers. Validate billing events end-to-end.
Phase 1 — Beta opt-in (2025-02-25 to 2025-03-17): invited customers opt into new SKUs; Sales/CS actively onboard top 20 accounts.
Phase 2 — Soft launch (2025-03-18 to 2025-03-31): new customers default to new SKUs; legacy customers remain on old tiers until migration window closes.
Phase 3 — Full launch & migration start (2025-04-01): begin automated migration reminders and batch migrations per agreed schedule.

Rollback criteria: critical billing reconciliation discrepancies > 0.5% of invoices or customer-reported charge incidents > 5% of pilot cohort -> pause and rollback to legacy metering for affected cohorts.
